page_title: DOR 1-0 KOL | Dortmund v FC Koln 19/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: Morey Bauza M. Lacking Match Fitness

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' FC Koln have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+5' It seemed like Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
90+2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Donyell Malen (Dortmund) was quite harsh and Deniz Aytekin didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+1' The referee allows time for a substitution. Rasmus Carstensen will be replaced by Luca Kilian (1. FC Koln).
90+1' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
88' 1 - 0 Goal! The resulting corner is whipped into the box and Donyell Malen (Dortmund) buries the ball into the back of the net from a Felix Nmecha knock down. 1:0.
88' Thorgan Hazard (Dortmund) will deliver the corner kick.
86' The resulting set piece from Dortmund is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
84' Here is a change. Julian Ryerson is going off and Edin Terzic gives the last tactical orders to Thorgan Hazard (Dortmund).
83' The substitution has been made. Marius Wolf (Dortmund) has replaced Ramy Bensebaini.
81' Youssoufa Moukoko (Dortmund) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.

79' Mathias Olesen (1. FC Koln) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the bottom left corner. The effort, however, is blocked by Gregor Kobel, who pulls off a stunning save!
76' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln).
74' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
72' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
69' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Marco Reus.
66' Steffen Baumgart has decided to substitute Florian Kainz and he is replaced by Mathias Olesen (1. FC Koln).
66' A substitution has been made. Luca Waldschmidt is replaced by Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln).
64' Mats Hummels (Dortmund) wins the ball from the resulting free kick and blazes his shot high over the crossbar!
61' A cross from Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
59' Edin Terzic prepares a substitution. Sebastien Haller is replaced by Youssoufa Moukoko (Dortmund).
59' Substitution. Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) in, Emre Can out.
58' Benno Schmitz (1. FC Koln) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
57' Sebastien Haller (Dortmund) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
56' An attempted cross from Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln) is cleared.
54' The corner kick from Julian Brandt (Dortmund) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
52' Steffen Baumgart decides to make a substitution. Davie Selke will be replaced by Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln).
50' FC Koln take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
49' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by FC Koln, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
49' Marco Reus (Dortmund) was too forceful with his tackle and Deniz Aytekin interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
48' Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' Deniz Aytekin has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
43' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
41' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 1:1.
39' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
37' A pass into the penalty area from Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) is intercepted by the defence.
34' Dortmund are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
32' The corner is swung in but Dortmund can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
31' The resulting corner from Julian Brandt (Dortmund) is cleared by the opposition's defence. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Dortmund.
30' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Dortmund comes to nothing.
27' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
25' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
23' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
21' Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) commits a rough challenge and Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle for a foul.
20' Davie Selke (1. FC Koln) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
18' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for FC Koln.
16' Deniz Aytekin couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) and blew his whistle.
14' A pass by Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
12' Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
9' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
6' Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.

5' Sebastien Haller (Dortmund) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Deniz Aytekin with no other option than to blow for a foul.
3' Emre Can (Dortmund) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
2' Dortmund seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. FC Koln will have the kick-off.
Deniz Aytekin will officiate today.
